title: list_user_mailboxes called on every Email/query request
description: In server.rs, Email/query calls list_user_mailboxes on every request to check if the mailbox_id is a special folder. Mailbox/get calls it again separately. Both are full DB round-trips with no caching. At modest load this is a hot path. Mitigation: fetch once per request batch dispatch and reuse the result.
